thread:
laura_support: heads up — enterprise customer reported data loss after our autorouter picked a destructive tool. they intended a refund but we routed to `delete_payment`. request id req_0ab12, customer env prod-us-west. urgent please

sam_engineer: omg, deleting payments? can you paste the original payload they sent? trying to repro locally

laura_support: pasted payload below. they called the chat completion with function calling enabled, plain text intent 'refund to card'.

```json
{
  \"user_id\": \"acct_987\",
  \"intent\": \"refund\",
  \"amount_cents\": 5000,
  \"order_id\": \"ord_444\",
  \"payment_method\": \"card\"
}
```

ari_bot: tool_call logged: { tool: \"delete_payment\", caller: \"autorouter\", args: \"{\\\"payment_id\\\":\\\"pay_123\\\"}\" } (trace id trace-2110004321)

sam_engineer: that's the issue — autorouter resolved to `delete_payment` by alias collision. both `refund_payment` and `delete_payment` share the short alias `payment` in the tool registry.

mike_oncall: do we have a quick rollback or recovery for pay_123? any db backups?

laura_support: customer says 1 payment record vanished from UI, transactions show voided. they want immediate restore or at least stop further autoroutes.

sam_engineer: mitigation: disabling autorouter for that customer namespace and revoking function-call permission should stop new calls. i'm going to 1) flag account on edge routing 2) push a hotfix to resolver precedence to prefer explicit verbs (refund over delete).

jess_product: need to log this in escalation tracker and ping legal/compliance — destructive tool got selected when user intent didn't include deletion. also propose changing tool naming to avoid ambiguous verbs.

lex_research: adding note — our signature matching currently uses token overlap + alias weights. short-term change: bump semantic intent matching to prefer refund-related embeddings for words like \"refund\", \"return\", \"reimburse\".

mike_oncall: any repro steps I can run to simulate?

sam_engineer: repro: run the chat completion with function list including both tools and a short prompt like `refund to card` and low temperature. autorouter picks the highest alias score. sample curl below:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"refund to card for order ord_444"}],
  "functions": [ /* refund_payment and delete_payment present */ ],
  "function_call": "auto"
}'
```

laura_support: i've disabled autorouter for acct_987 and filed the customer ticket with incident#INC-2110. customer asked for restore ETA

sam_engineer: DB team: we can restore pay_123 from last snapshot (T-5m). starting restore to a sandbox first. will update in 30m.

jess_product: follow-up: propose default policy change — block any autorouter selection of tools with verb `delete` unless explicit confirmation present. will write RFC after incident stabilizes. :memo:

laura_support: thanks all. keeping customer updated. will post final resolution when restore and hotfix land. :thumbsup:
